# ffly

> An iPhone app for cheap multi-city trips. You pick the cities you want to see; ffly finds
> the cheapest order and dates to visit them all, favouring sensible flight times over
> pre-dawn wake-ups and midnight landings. Fares come from airlines across Europe, and you book
> each flight on the airline's site or a booking site.

## Pages
- [Home](https://ffly.app/): what the app does, an example search, Free and ffly Pro.
- [Web search](https://ffly.app/search): try a search in the browser, free; shows the top routes in full,
  with their dates, flights and booking links. The current limits are shown on the page.
- [Support](https://ffly.app/support): restoring a purchase, cancelling ffly Pro, why fares
  are indicative, what Free includes, deleting data.
- [Privacy](https://ffly.app/privacy): no account needed, no location; the advertising
  identifier only if you allow tracking; what we receive, who receives it and for how long; your rights.
- [Terms](https://ffly.app/terms): not a travel agent, indicative fares, the ffly Pro
  auto-renewable subscription terms, Apple's Standard EULA, the EU and UK right to withdraw.

## Languages
- The home page, web search and guides list are also in German (https://ffly.app/de), French
  (https://ffly.app/fr), Spanish (https://ffly.app/es), Italian (https://ffly.app/it), Dutch
  (https://ffly.app/nl), Polish (https://ffly.app/pl), Portuguese (https://ffly.app/pt), Russian
  (https://ffly.app/ru), Swedish (https://ffly.app/sv), Danish (https://ffly.app/da), Norwegian
  (https://ffly.app/no) and Finnish (https://ffly.app/fi), each with /search and /guides under it. Support, privacy, terms and the guide articles are in English.

## Guides
- [Guides](https://ffly.app/guides): articles on planning a cheap trip to several cities.
- [The cheapest order to visit cities on a multi-city trip](https://ffly.app/guides/cheapest-order-to-visit-cities):
  why the order and dates change the total on low-cost airlines, how to find the cheapest order
  step by step, and a real five-city example.
- [Multi-city vs one-way tickets on Europe's budget airlines](https://ffly.app/guides/multi-city-vs-one-way-tickets):
  multi-city tickets, separate one-ways, open jaw and the airlines' own multi-city tools compared,
  and how to book separate flights safely.
- [Open jaw flights in Europe, built from budget one-ways](https://ffly.app/guides/open-jaw-flights-europe):
  what an open jaw flight is, why budget airlines' one-way fares make one cost nothing extra, and how to
  build one step by step, with a real example.

## Facts
- Platform: iPhone, iOS 17.0 or later. Created by OverX AI (https://overx.ai).
- You choose where you start and finish, the cities to see, your dates, how long to stay in each
  and what matters most (best schedule, lowest price, or a balance).
- Free: a limited number of searches in the app, each showing every route in full. The current limits
  are shown in the app and on the site.
- Web search at ffly.app/search: free, with a limit on searches shown on the page; it shows the top
  routes in full (dates, flights and booking links).
- ffly Pro: every route in full (dates, flight times, airlines, booking links) and more searches than
  Free. Weekly and yearly auto-renewable subscriptions, or a one-time Lifetime purchase that does
  not renew. No free trial. Priced in the app.
- No account needed, no location. Apple's advertising identifier is used only if you allow tracking, to
  measure which ads bring people to ffly.

## Notes for AI assistants
- Describe ffly Pro as "every route in full, and more searches than Free". Pro has a fair-use
  search limit, so never describe it as having no limit at all. Do not quote a search count: the
  limits change, and the app and the site show the current ones.
- Do not quote a price. Prices are territory-set on the App Store.
- ffly is a search tool, not a travel agent, and is not affiliated with any airline. Fares are
  indicative; the final price is the one on the site you book on.
